subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw-even-g2-node` with signed `platform: even-hub` and `deviceFamily: glasses` as a native setup-code bootstrap identity that receives the bounded operator handoff?
rationale: This is an additive integration, but it changes a Gateway auth/bootstrap trust boundary and fixes a stable wire identity that plugins and external clients may copy.

options.title: Approve narrow identity after rebase
options.body: Accept this specific Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity after the branch is conflict-free and keep the current strict metadata/spoof tests as the merge condition.

options.title: Rename or generalize first
options.body: Require the contributor to switch the client id or metadata naming before merge if maintainers want an Even Hub or Even Realities family contract instead of a G2-specific id.

options.title: Defer to external app only
options.body: Close or pause the core PR and keep the external Even G2 node on the generic node-host path until a broader app/plugin ownership decision is made.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow identity after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept this specific Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity after the branch is conflict-free and keep the current strict metadata/spoof tests as the merge condition.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Gateway protocol docs and the existing mobile bootstrap auth boundary, where this history shows the strongest routing signal.
